graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp.on_mount

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._load_path_from_user_input
examples: (P-15, probe p9a U3) the work-area path `…/.s19tool/workarea/ab` → status "Unsupported file type: " (holds at 4fef292; RED side of AT-B100-12)
(P-15, probe p9a U3) `…/workarea/ab/project.json` → status "Unsupported file type: .json" (holds at 4fef292)
(TC-B100-38, LLR-172.5) `ab`, `ab/project.json` and `ab` reached through a `..` segment → `3` loads of `ab` (target (9a))

(probe p9a U3) the bare name `ab` typed with the base folder as working directory → status "File not found: ab" (holds at 4fef292: `resolve_input_path` tries the working directory, the base folder and the repository root, never the work area — see baseline-notes C2)

(TC-B100-38, LLR-172.5, S-01) `temp`, `TEMP`, `patches` typed → `0` project loads, `0` files written (target (9a); bare names give "File not found: temp" at 4fef292 — probe p9a U3 — so a bare-name arm is not RED on base, C2)
(TC-B100-38) an empty folder inside the work area → `1` line holding "not a project" (target (9a))
(TC-B100-38) a folder outside the work area holding a `project.json` → `1` line holding "outside the work area", `0` project loads (target (9a))
(TC-B100-38) `firmware` with no suffix, an existing file → `1` line holding "not a supported file" (target (9a); at 4fef292 "Unsupported file type: ")
graph_nodes.func: the typed-path router: `resolve_input_path(path, self.base_dir)`; `None` → "File not found: …"; an A2L suffix → `load_a2l_from_path(path)`; a data suffix → `load_from_path(path)`; anything else (a folder has the empty suffix) → "Unsupported file type: <suffix>". No folder or project branch, no work-area resolution. 9a changes: (a) a resolved path that is a project folder of this work area, or that folder's `project.json`, loads that project (through `_handle_load_project`, see baseline-notes C3); (b) any other folder inside the work area → the `not a project` tokens; a folder outside → the `outside the work area` tokens; a file with no or an unsupported suffix → `not a supported file` (LLR-172.5); (c) a reserved home never loads (S-01).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp.load_from_path
examples: (AT-B100-12, LLR-172.1) `examples/case_01_basic_valid/firmware.s19` loaded → the per-user store lists its absolute path, kind "s19" (target (9a))
(LLR-172.1) 25 distinct outside loads → `20` entries, newest first; the same file twice → `1` entry (target (9a))
(LLR-172.1) a source inside the work area (a project variant through `_handle_select_variant`) → `0` entries (target (9a))
(LLR-172.1) a failed load → `0` entries (target (9a); see C1: a parse failure is reported by `_handle_load_error` after this function returned)
(LLR-172.1, S-16) `LOCALAPPDATA` unset → `0` files written; `0` files named "recent_sources.json" under the base folder (target (9a))
(TC-B99-34, test_tc_b99_34_pick_loads_the_picked_file_name) `a.s19` loaded through the dialog → the Workarea Files list holds "a.s19" (holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: the data load: `resolve_input_path`, suffix check, `copy_into_workarea(normalized, workarea/temp, workarea_root=self.workarea)` (a containment refusal → "Cannot load file: …"), then `_start_load_worker(copied)` and, on the next idle frame, `refresh_files()`. Returns before the parse: success or failure is known only in the worker. Also the variant-switch route (`_handle_select_variant`) with a path inside the open project. 9a changes: call `record_recent_source` for a source outside the work area after a successful load (LLR-172.1 "after a successful copy"; HLR-172 "loads successfully" — baseline-notes C1).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp.load_a2l_from_path
examples: (LLR-172.1) an A2L from a folder outside the work area loaded → `1` store entry with kind "a2l" (target (9a))
(LLR-172.1) the Workarea Files pick of `x.a2l` (a path inside `workarea/temp`) → `0` store entries (target (9a))
(LLR-172.1) a project open that already holds an A2L → status "Project already has an A2L file.", `0` store entries (target (9a); the refusal holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: the A2L load: `resolve_input_path`, suffix check, the open-project guard ("Project already has an A2L file."), `copy_into_workarea` into `workarea/temp`, `refresh_files()`, parse, `current_a2l_path` = the temp copy, view refresh, "A2L loaded: …", then `_sync_loaded_a2l_to_project` when a project is open. Synchronous: success is known before it returns. Also called by `_load_from_item` with a path already in `workarea/temp`. 9a changes: call `record_recent_source` for a source outside the work area after the successful copy (LLR-172.1).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._start_load_worker
examples: (LLR-172.1, C1) a source that copies but fails to parse → `_handle_load_error` runs and `_apply_prepared_load` does not (holds at 4fef292 by reading the code)
graph_nodes.func: the thread worker (`@work(thread=True, exclusive=True, group="load")`): parses the copied file; an exception or an unsupported result → `_handle_load_error` on the main thread; else `_prepare_load_payload`, then `_apply_prepared_load` and `set_progress(100, …)` on the main thread, then `_sync_loaded_file_to_project` when a project is open. Receives the work copy, not the source path. Unchanged by 9a unless the record moves to the success point (C1).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._apply_prepared_load
examples: (TC-B99-34) a valid `a.s19` → the install runs once and the status names the file (holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: the main-thread install of a parsed load: the one point where a data load is known to have succeeded. Its `path` is the work copy in `workarea/temp`. Unchanged by 9a unless it becomes the record point (C1).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._handle_load_error
examples: (LLR-172.1) a `.s19` source whose bytes do not parse → a failure status, `0` store entries (target (9a) for the store; the failure status holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: the main-thread failure handler of the load worker: status and progress reset. Unchanged by 9a; "a failed load → 0 entries" is decided by whether the record runs before or after this point (C1).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp.refresh_files
examples: (AT-B100-13, TC-B100-39, LLR-172.6) files `[bold]x.s19`, `[link=x]a.s19`, `[@click=app.bell]x.s19` and a name holding U+009B in `temp/` → `4` rows whose plain text equals the name minus control characters, `0` spans, `0` control characters (target (9a))
(HLR-172 negative control, P-24 QA-02 probe) `[bold]x.s19` → `1` span painted (holds at 4fef292; RED side of AT-B100-13)
(TC-B100-37, LLR-172.4) a file link and `.staging` in `temp/` → `0` of them listed (target (9a); at 4fef292 a file link is listed because `is_file()` follows it — by reading the code, not run)
(TC-B100-37, LLR-172.4) the AST census of `s19_app/` → `1` function enumerating `temp/` (target (9a); at 4fef292 this function is the one enumeration of `temp/` — baseline-notes "Listers")
(TC-B99-36) after one load of `one.s19` → items "one.s19" only, no ".staging" (holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: the Workarea Files list: clears `#files_list`, `sorted((workarea/temp).glob("*"))`, keeps `item.is_file()` (follows a file link; skips `.staging` only because it is a folder), appends `ListItem(Label(item.name))` with `entry.data = item.name`. `Label` parses markup by default (P-24). 9a changes: (a) build the list from `list_workarea_files(self.workarea)` — regular, non-link files of `temp/`, `.staging` excluded (LLR-172.4); (b) each label through `safe_text(item.name)` (LLR-172.6). `entry.data` stays the raw name, the pick's source.

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._load_from_item
examples: (TC-B99-34) the item with data "a b.s19" picked → that file loads (holds at 4fef292)
(LLR-172.6 consequence) an item named with U+009B picked → the file of that exact name loads, not the scrubbed label's name (target (9a) to keep)
graph_nodes.func: the Workarea Files pick: reads `item.data`, `candidate = workarea/temp/<name>`, when it exists an A2L suffix → `load_a2l_from_path(candidate)` (copies onto itself: byte-identical reuse), anything else → `load_selected_file(candidate)` in place. Unchanged by 9a; it must keep reading `item.data`, never the painted label (the safe_text label differs from the name when it held a control character).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp.load_selected_file
examples: (LLR-172.1) a Workarea Files pick of `one.s19` → `0` store entries (target (9a))
graph_nodes.func: the synchronous in-place load of a data file (no copy): parse, install. Reached by the Workarea Files pick and the project load. Unchanged by 9a; a work-area pick is not an outside load, so it records nothing.

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._handle_select_variant
examples: (LLR-172.1 "a source inside the work area → 0 entries") the open project's second variant selected → `0` store entries (target (9a))
graph_nodes.func: the variant switch: finds the descriptor, then `load_from_path(descriptor.path)` with a path inside the open project folder. Unchanged by 9a; the record in `load_from_path` must skip it (a source inside the work area).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp.action_load_project
examples: (test_b99_load_project.py:335) an empty work area → status "No saved projects found." (holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: the Load project key (`p`): `list_projects()`; empty → "No saved projects found."; else LoadProjectScreen with `_route_load_project`. Unchanged by 9a.

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._route_load_project
examples: (LLR-178.3) a cancelled pick, name `None` → no Load-result panel (holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: the Load project router: `_handle_load_project(name)`, then LoadResultScreen when a new announcement was composed. The only production caller of `_handle_load_project` at 4fef292. Unchanged by 9a; the typed project route either calls it (the Load-result panel opens) or calls `_handle_load_project` directly (no panel) — C3.

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._handle_load_project
examples: (S-01, probe p9a U4) name `temp`, `workarea/temp` holding `firmware.s19` → status "Loaded project 'temp'", current_project "temp" (holds at 4fef292; RED side of TC-B100-38's reserved arms)
(S-01, probe p9a U5) name `TEMP` → status "Loaded project 'TEMP'" (holds at 4fef292)
(TC-B100-38, LLR-172.5) names `temp`, `TEMP`, `patches` → `0` project loads, `0` session resets, `0` files written (target (9a))
(probe p9a U6) name `E`, an empty folder → status "has no project.json" (holds at 4fef292)
(TC-B100-62, test_tc_b100_62_load_refuses_a_junction_project) name `evil`, a junction → a line holding "is a link or junction", `0` resets (holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: Load project: `project_dir = workarea / name`; `_project_folder_refusal` ("link", "unreadable", "outside" → "Project NOT loaded: …"); exists; validate_project_files; the A2L checks; neither data nor A2L → "has no data or A2L file" / "has no project.json"; then the session reset and the install. No reserved-home check: `temp` and `TEMP` load as projects. 9a changes: refuse any name `list_projects` would not list — a reserved home compared case-folded, a link, a non-project — before the reset (LLR-172.5, S-01).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp.list_projects
examples: (TC-B99-35, test_tc_b99_35_reserved_homes_are_not_projects) empty folders `P1`, `P2` and every reserved home → projects "P1", "P2" (holds at 4fef292; an empty folder is listed)
(probe p9a U1) `ab` with `project.json` and an empty `E` → projects "ab", "E" (holds at 4fef292)
(§1.3 "Project", LLR-172.5 "a non-project") an empty `E` → not listed (target (9a) only if C4 is decided that way; it breaks TC-B99-35 as written)
graph_nodes.func: every direct child of the work area, sorted, whose case-folded name is not a reserved home, that `_project_folder_refusal` passes and `is_dir()`. No content check: an empty folder is listed, unlike the §1.3 "Project" definition (holds a `project.json`, a data file or an A2L). 9a changes: none stated; LLR-172.5 makes it the predicate `_handle_load_project` refuses by ("any name `list_projects` would not list … a non-project"), which it does not compute today (C4).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._project_folder_refusal
examples: (LLR-171.4) `workarea/evil`, a junction → reason "link" (holds at 4fef292)
(S-01) `workarea/temp` → reason `None` (holds at 4fef292 by reading the code)

(LLR-172.5 "`ab` reached through a `..` segment") a folder spelled `workarea/x/../ab` → reason "outside" because the parent text is not the work area (holds at 4fef292 by reading the code; the typed router must normalise first — C2)
graph_nodes.func: the one folder check of HLR-171b: `folder.parent` textually equal to `self.workarea` and a plain name, else "outside"; `os.lstat` (absent → `None`, other error → "unreadable"); link or reparse point → "link"; `contained_in_workarea` → "outside". No reserved-home and no content check. Unchanged by 9a unless the reserved-home / non-project test joins it (C4).

graph_nodes.name: S19TuiApp._handle_save_dialog
examples: (TC-B100-05, test_tc_b100_05_case_only_match_against_another_project_refused) a typed name differing only in case from another project's folder → refused (holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: Save project. Listed for one part only: the clash scan `for item in sorted(self.workarea.iterdir())` — a third enumeration of the work-area root, with its own "is a project" test (`project.json` is a file, or a child with a data or A2L suffix; not reserved; not a reparse point). Unchanged by 9a; it does not enumerate `temp/`, so TC-B100-37's census does not count it.

graph_nodes.name: resolve_input_path
examples: (probe p9a U3) `ab` with the base folder as working directory and the project at `workarea/ab` → `None` (holds at 4fef292)
(P-15) the absolute work-area path of `ab` → that path (holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: strips spaces and quotes, `expanduser`; returns the candidate when it exists as typed (relative to the working directory, unresolved), else `base_dir / candidate` resolved, else the repository root's, else `None`. Never tries the work area; a relative existing path returns unresolved, so `..` segments stay. Unchanged by 9a unless the typed project route adds a work-area base (C2).

graph_nodes.name: copy_into_workarea
examples: (TC-B99-34) `a.s19` from outside into `workarea/temp` → placed ends "a.s19" (holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: one statement over `place_into_workarea(...).path`: every guard, the byte-identical reuse and the `_<N>` claim. Both load paths copy through it; "after a successful copy" (LLR-172.1) means after it returns. Unchanged by 9a; the store is not in a work area and must not be written through it.

graph_nodes.name: contained_in_workarea
examples: (LLR-172.1) the example `examples/case_01_basic_valid/firmware.s19` against the test work area → contained `False` (holds at 4fef292 by reading the code)
(LLR-172.1) `workarea/ab/firmware.s19` → contained `True` (holds at 4fef292 by reading the code)
graph_nodes.func: true iff the path, after resolving every link, is inside `workarea.resolve()`. Unchanged by 9a; the natural test for "a source outside the work area" (LLR-172.1) and "a folder outside it" (LLR-172.5).

graph_nodes.name: _is_reparse_point
examples: (LLR-172.1) the store folder `%LOCALAPPDATA%\s19_app` replaced by a junction → is_link `True`, `0` writes (target (9a) for the writer; the predicate holds)
graph_nodes.func: true for a symbolic link or a Windows reparse point; the path need not exist. Unchanged by 9a; LLR-172.1 checks the store folder with it before `os.replace`, LLR-172.4's lister skips links with it.

graph_nodes.name: validate_project_files

out.raw: tuple(list[Path] data_files, list[Path] a2l_files, Optional[str] error)

examples: (S-01, probe p9a U2) `workarea/temp` holding `firmware.s19` → data_files "firmware.s19", error `None` (holds at 4fef292; the S-01 probe the negative control cites)
graph_nodes.func: lists the direct regular-file children of a folder: S19/HEX/MAC as data, A2L apart. It accepts any folder, `temp` included. Unchanged by 9a.

graph_nodes.name: is_windows_device_name
examples: (TC-B100-35, LLR-172.2) the component `NUL.s19` of `C:\x\NUL.s19` → is_device `True` (holds at 4fef292 by the HLR-164 tests)
graph_nodes.func: the shared device-name predicate (CON, PRN, AUX, NUL, COM0–9, LPT0–9, superscript digits, CONIN$, CONOUT$; case-folded, any extension). Unchanged by 9a; LLR-172.2 reuses it per path component of a store entry.

graph_nodes.name: safe_text
examples: (TC-B100-39) value `[bold]x.s19` → text plain "[bold]x.s19", `0` spans (holds at 4fef292 by LLR-116.7's tests)
(S-06) a value holding U+009B → plain text without it (holds at 4fef292)
graph_nodes.func: deletes every C0/C1 control code point, then wraps the rest as a literal `Text` (no markup). Unchanged by 9a; the label builder of LLR-172.6.
